title: NuclearScience Iodine131DecayAnalysis

stats.done_summary: Completed the analysis of flame speed vs chamber pressure. The data was split into two regimes (< 82 kPa and >= 82 kPa). A power-law model was fitted to the first regime and a linear model to the second. The models and data were plotted and saved to report/images/final_model_plot.png. A comprehensive report was written in report/report.md detailing the methodology, results, and discussion.
